'''Ginger tea''' is a drink brewed from fresh ginger. Some use it to soothe coughs and sore throats. It is also sometimes sipped to warm up the body.

==Ingredients==
*Fresh [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
*Water
*[[Cookbook:Sweeteners|Sweetener]] (optional)

==Procedure==
#Cut ginger into small pieces, and rinse to remove dirt.
#Add water to the sliced ginger and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
#Allow to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for a few minutes, then [[Cookbook:Straining|strain]] the drink to remove ginger particles.
#Add sweetener to taste, and serve.
